name: SIGTERM root cause — Worker ssh_execute invisible kills
description: Worker ssh_execute kill commands don't appear in bash_history; always set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES on first submit; save checkpoint before killing high-progress training
type: feedback
---

Worker agent sending `kill` via ssh_execute is invisible in bash_history — makes post-mortem difficult.

**Why:** D083 investigation (2026-05-15) revealed v1/v2 of d100_s42_a32 were killed by Worker agent itself (not OOM/cron/manual). v2 was at 72% progress when killed, wasting ~3.5 hours GPU time. Root cause: v1 had no CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, landed on occupied GPU 0, triggering Worker to kill and retry.

**How to apply:**
1. First submission of any training job MUST include explicit `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=N` — never rely on default GPU assignment
2. Before killing a training process at >50% progress, trigger checkpoint save first (or support resume)
3. When Worker kills a process via ssh_execute, require logging the kill reason to a file (e.g., `/tmp/kill_reason_{pid}.log`) for post-mortem traceability
